sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Okay, did you study all the time?
sentences.ipa: /oʊˈkeɪ, dɪd juː ˈstʌdi duː juː ˈstʌdi ɔːl ðə taɪm?/
sentences.zh: 好的，你平时一直在学习吗？

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Are you a hard worker or do things just come easy for you?
sentences.ipa: /ɑːr juː ə hɑːrd ˈwɜːrkər ɔːr duː θɪŋz ʤʌst kʌm ˈiːzi fɔːr juː?/
sentences.zh: 你是个工作努力的人，还是事情对你来说轻而易举？

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: I did take every single available online test for the SAT, so I'm not going to sit back and be like, oh, it was easy.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ dɪd teɪk ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl əˈveɪləbəl ˈɑːnˌlaɪn tɛst fɔːr ðə ɛs-eɪ-ti, soʊ aɪm nɑːt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː sɪt bæk ænd biː laɪk, oʊ, ɪt wʌz ˈiːzi./
sentences.zh: 我的确参加了 SAT 的所有在线模拟测试，所以我不会坐在那儿说，哦，这很简单。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: But um, yeah, it was just standardized tests and you can study for them.
sentences.ipa: /bʌt ʌm, jææ, ɪt wʌz ɪt wʌz ʤʌst ˈstændərˌdaɪzd tɛsts ænd juː kən ˈstʌdi fɔːr ðɛm./
sentences.zh: 但嗯，是的，这只是标准化考试，你可以为它们进行复习。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Well, hard work seems to be your theme.
sentences.ipa: /wɛl, hɑːrd wɜːrk siːmz tuː biː jɔːr θiːm./
sentences.zh: 嗯，努力工作似乎一直是你的主题。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: When you got those medals in Beijing, was it a pinch me moment or was it like lots and lots of practice that happened to work out perfectly on that day?
sentences.ipa: /ʌ-, wɛn juː ɡɑːt ðoʊz ˈmɛdəlz ɪn bɪˈʤɪŋ, wʌz ɪt wʌz ɪt ə pɪnʧ miː ˈmoʊmənt ɔːr wʌz ɪt laɪk lɑːts ænd lɑːts ʌv ˈpræktɪs ðæt ˈhæpənd tuː wɜːrk aʊt ˈpɜːrfɪktli ɑːn ðæt deɪ?/
sentences.zh: 呃，当你在北京获得那些奖牌时，这是一个“掐我一下”的时刻，还是说大量的练习恰好在那天完美地发挥出来了？

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: I think it was both, the really standout moment for me was when I landed that 1620 in Big Air, which was my first event.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪt wʌz boʊθ, ðə ˈrɪli ˈstændaʊt ˈmoʊmənt fɔːr miː wʌz wɛn aɪ ˈlændɪd ðæt ˈsɪkˈstiːn ˈtwɛnti ɪn bɪɡ ɛr, wɪʧ wʌz maɪ fɜːrst ɪˈvɛnt./
sentences.zh: 我认为两者兼有，对我而言最突出的时刻是我在首个项目大跳台上落地了 1620 度。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: And I've always said, you know, my message is about inspiring young girls and inspiring more people to hear about the sport and to use it as a force to create interconnection and cross-cultural communication.
sentences.ipa: /ænd aɪv ˈɔːlweɪz sɛd, juː noʊ, maɪ ˈmɛsɪʤ ɪz əˈbaʊt ɪnˈspaɪərɪŋ jʌŋ ɡɜːrlz ænd ʌm ɪnˈspaɪərɪŋ mɔːr ˈpiːpəl tuː hɪr əˈbaʊt ðə spɔːrt ænd tuː juːz ɪt æz ə fɔːrs tuː kriˈeɪt ˌɪntərkəˈnɛkʃən ænd krɔːs-ˈkʌlʧərəl kəmˌjunəˈkeɪʃən./
sentences.zh: 我一直都说，你知道，我的传达的信息是激励年轻女孩，并且激励更多人去了解这项运动，并将其作为建立联系和跨文化交流的力量。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: And I knew that it was such a big moment and there were so many people watching and it was my time to live up to that standard that I've set.
sentences.ipa: /ænd aɪ nuː ðæt ɪt wʌz sʌʧ ə bɪɡ ˈmoʊmənt ænd ðɛr wɜːr soʊ ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ˈwɑːʧɪŋ ænd ɪt wʌz maɪ taɪm tuː lɪv ʌp tuː ðæt ˈstændərd ðæt aɪv sɛt./
sentences.zh: 我知道这是一个非常重大的时刻，有那么多人正在观看，这是我达到我所设定的标准的时候。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: And so in that sense, I was like, no matter what, there is no failure, because if I don't land, the worst failure is to not try.
sentences.ipa: /ænd soʊ ɪn ðæt sɛns, aɪ wʌz laɪk, noʊ ˈmætər wʌt, ðɛr ɪz noʊ ˈfeɪljər, bɪˈkʌz ɪf aɪ doʊnt lænd, ðə wɜːrst ˈfeɪljər ɪz tuː nɑːt traɪ./
sentences.zh: 所以在某种意义上，我想，无论如何，都没有失败，因为如果我不去落地，最糟糕的失败就是不去尝试。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: So, I just wanted to try it and I'd never done it before, I'd never even tried it on airbag or anything.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ, aɪ ʤʌst ˈwɑːntɪd tuː traɪ ɪt ænd aɪd ˈnɛvər dʌn ɪt bɪˈfɔːr, aɪd ˈnɛvər ˈiːvən traɪd ɪt ɑːn ˈɛrˌbæɡ ɔːr ˈɛniˌθɪŋ./
sentences.zh: 所以，我只是想去尝试一下，我以前从没做过，甚至在气垫上都从没试过。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: And landed it, got that gold medal and I was on top of the world.
sentences.ipa: /ænd ˈlændɪd ɪt, ɡɑːt ðæt ɡoʊld ˈmɛdəl ænd aɪ wʌz ɑːn tɑːp ʌv ðə wɜːrld./
sentences.zh: 结果成功落地了，拿到了金牌，我感觉自己站在了世界之巅。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Well, your mom taught you well, you can tell that she's always supporting you, she's actually here in studio.
sentences.ipa: /wɛl, jɔːr mɑːm tɔːt juː wɛl, juː kən tɛl ðæt ʃiːz ˈɔːlweɪz səˈpɔːrtɪŋ juː, ʃiːz ˈækʧuəli hɪr ɪn ˈstudiˌoʊ./
sentences.zh: 嗯，你妈妈把你教得很好，看得出她一直都在支持你，她其实就来到我们的演播室了。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: But I can give an example if that's helpful.
sentences.ipa: /bʌt aɪ kən gɪv ən ɪgˈzæmpəl ɪf ðæts ˈhɛlpfəl/
sentences.zh: 但如果这样有帮助的话，我可以举个例子。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: Two days ago, I was in New Zealand, I was training on snow because it's reverse season.
sentences.ipa: /tu deɪz əˈgoʊ, aɪ wɪz ɪn nu ˈziələnd, aɪ wɪz ˈtreɪnɪŋ ɑn snoʊ bɪˈkəz ɪts rɪˈvɜrs ˈsizən/
sentences.zh: 两天前，我在新西兰，我在雪地上训练，因为那是反季。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: So I finished skiing, drove straight to the airport in my full ski gear,.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃt ˈskiɪŋ, droʊv streɪt tu ði ˈɛrpɔrt ɪn maɪ fʊl ski gɪr/
sentences.zh: 所以我滑完雪后，穿着全套滑雪装备直接开车去了机场，

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: Changed at the airport in five minutes, packed it into a suitcase that I had half-packed.
sentences.ipa: /ʧeɪnʤd æt ði ˈɛrpɔrt ɪn faɪv ˈmɪnəts, pækt ɪt ˈɪntu ə ˈsutkeɪs ðæt aɪ hæd hæf-pækt/
sentences.zh: 在机场花五分钟换好衣服，把它塞进一个我只装了一半的行李箱里。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: And so I put it into the empty half, zipped it up, sent it into the bag check,.
sentences.ipa: /ænd soʊ aɪ pʊt ɪt ˈɪntu ði ˈɛmpti hæf, zɪpt ɪt ʌp, sɛnt ɪt ˈɪntu ðə bæg ʧɛk/
sentences.zh: 然后我把它放进空着的那半边，拉上拉链，办理了行李托运，

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: Flew from New Zealand to China,.
sentences.ipa: /flu frʌm nu ˈziələnd tu ˈʧaɪnə/
sentences.zh: 从新西兰飞往中国，

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: And on that flight I, I don't know, read 100 pages of my book, wrote a couple of pages to be published, and then slept the rest of the time.
sentences.ipa: /ænd ɑn ðæt flaɪt aɪ, aɪ doʊnt noʊ, rid ˈhʌndrəd ˈpeɪʤəz ʌv maɪ bʊk, roʊt ə ˈkʌpəl ʌv ˈpeɪʤəz tu bi ˈpʌblɪʃt, ænd ðɛn slɛpt ðə rɛst ʌv ðə taɪm/
sentences.zh: 在那个航班上，我，我不知道，读了100页书，写了几页准备发表的文章，然后剩下的时间都在睡觉。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: Landed at 5 in the morning, started shooting at 6, shot 10 hours, and then ran 10 miles afterwards and went to sleep.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlændɪd æt faɪv ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ, ˈstɑrtɪd ˈʃutɪŋ æt sɪks, ʃɑt tɛn ˈaʊərz, ænd ðɛn ræn tɛn maɪlz ˈæftərwərdz ænd wɛnt tu slip/
sentences.zh: 早上5点落地，6点开始拍摄，拍了10个小时，之后还跑了10英里才去睡觉。

sentences.speaker: Eileen Gu
sentences.en: So that would be a day in the life, but I don't know if I've ever done that day before and I might not do it again, but I think the one thing that stays consistent is the tempo.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ ðæt wʊd bi ə deɪ ɪn ðə laɪf, bʌt aɪ doʊnt noʊ ɪf aɪv ˈɛvər dʌn ðæt deɪ bɪˈfɔr ænd aɪ maɪt nɑt du ɪt əˈgɛn, bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ðə wʌn θɪŋ ðæt steɪz kənˈsɪstənt ɪz ðə ˈtɛmpoʊ/
sentences.zh: 这就是生活中的一天吧，但我不知道我以前有没有经历过这样的一天，以后可能也不会再这样了，但我认为保持不变的一点是节奏。

lessons.speaker: Jensen Huang
lessons.title: 黄仁勋回忆 14 岁：年少时就知道自己想当工程师吗？
lessons.firstSentence: #1 [0.0-5.0] When you were my age, which is 14, did you know that you wanted to be an engineer?
lessons.lastSentence: #11 [62.0-73.0] And so I don't know when I really decided I wanted to be an engineer, but I knew that I wanted to be in the analytical fields and in math and science ever since I was quite young.

practiceQuestions.qEn: What did Jensen Huang say about his behavior when he was 14?
practiceQuestions.qZh: 黄仁勋谈到自己14岁时的表现时说了什么？
practiceQuestions.aEn: He described himself as rambunctious, noting that he liked setting things on fire and building things.
practiceQuestions.aZh: 他形容自己很顽皮，并提到自己喜欢放火烧东西和搞建筑。

practiceQuestions.qEn: Which subject was Jensen Huang's favorite topic when he was young?
practiceQuestions.qZh: 黄仁勋小时候最喜欢的科目是什么？
practiceQuestions.aEn: Mathematics was his favorite topic.
practiceQuestions.aZh: 数学是他最喜欢的科目。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: When you were my age, which is 14, did you know that you wanted to be an engineer?
sentences.ipa: /wɛn ju wɜr maɪ eɪdʒ, wɪtʃ ɪz ˈfɔrtin, du ju dɪd ju noʊ ðæt ju ˈwɑntɪd tu bi ən ˈɛndʒəˌnɪr?/
sentences.zh: 当你像我这么大，也就是14岁时，你知道自己想成为一名工程师吗？

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Well, first of all, I think that if I were your mom, I wouldn't want me to tell you what I was doing when I was your age.
sentences.ipa: /wɛl, fɜrst əv ɔl, aɪ θɪŋk ðæt ɪf aɪ wɜr jʊər mɑm, aɪ ˈwʊdənt wɑnt mi tu tɛl ju wʌt aɪ wʌz ˈduɪŋ wɛn aɪ wʌz jʊər eɪdʒ./
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我想如果我是你妈妈，我不会希望我告诉你我像你这么大时在做什么。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: I wasn't a particularly good kid, I just turned out good.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ ˈwʌzənt ə pərˈtɪkjələrli gʊd kɪd, aɪ dʒʌst tɜrnd aʊt gʊd./
sentences.zh: 我以前不是个特别乖的孩子，我只是后来变好了。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: I was always rambunctious, I was always setting stuff on fire and gluing stuff together and blowing things up and, you know, digging holes in this and building that and whatnot.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ wʌz ˈɔlweɪz ræmˈbʌŋʃəs, aɪ wʌz ˈɔlweɪz ˈsɛtɪŋ stʌf ɑn ˈfaɪər ənd ˈgluɪŋ stʌf təˈgɛðər ənd ˈbloʊɪŋ θɪŋz ʌp ənd, ju noʊ, ˈdɪgɪŋ hoʊlz ɪn ðɪs ənd ˈbɪldɪŋ ðæt ənd ˈwʌtˌnɑt./
sentences.zh: 我总是很调皮，总是放火烧东西，把东西粘在一起，炸毁东西，你知道，在地上挖洞，建造那些乱七八糟的东西。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: So I was a rambunctious kid.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ aɪ wʌz ə ræmˈbʌŋʃəs kɪd./
sentences.zh: 所以我曾经是个很调皮的孩子。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: But I always cared deeply about grades and I always knew that I wanted to do something in mathematics.
sentences.ipa: /bʌt, bʌt ʌm aɪ ˈɔlweɪz kɛrd ˈdipli əˈbaʊt greɪdz ənd aɪ ˈɔlweɪz nu ðæt aɪ ˈwɑntɪd tu du ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ˌmæθəˈmætɪks./
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，我一直非常关心成绩，我一直知道我想在数学领域做点事情。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: That was probably my favorite topic.
sentences.ipa: /ðæt wʌz ˈprɑbəbli maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈtɑpɪk./
sentences.zh: 那可能是我最喜欢的科目。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: And ultimately, I chose engineering because engineering has a lot of math.
sentences.ipa: /ænd ˈʌltəmətli, aɪ tʃoʊz ˌɛndʒəˈnɪrɪŋ bɪˈkəz ˌɛndʒəˈnɪrɪŋ hæz ə lɑt əv mæθ./
sentences.zh: 最终，我选择工程学是因为工程学包含很多数学。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: And for somebody who has an analytical mind, who likes to build things, who likes to make things the world's never seen.
sentences.ipa: /ænd ənd fɔr ˈsʌmbədi hu hu ʌm hu hæz ən ˌænəˈlɪtɪkəl maɪnd, ʌ hu laɪks tu bɪld θɪŋz, ʌ hu laɪks tu ʌ meɪk θɪŋz ðə wɜrldz ˈnɛvər sin./
sentences.zh: 对于那些拥有分析头脑的人来说，喜欢建造东西，喜欢创造前所未见的事物。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Being an engineer is the perfect career.
sentences.ipa: /ʌ ˈbiɪŋ ən ˌɛndʒəˈnɪr ɪz ðə ɪz ðə ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈpɜrfɪkt ʌ ˈpɜrfɪkt kəˈrɪr./
sentences.zh: 成为一名工程师可以说是最完美、最完美的职业。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: And so I don't know when I really decided I wanted to be an engineer, but I knew that I wanted to be in the analytical fields and in math and science ever since I was quite young.
sentences.ipa: /ænd soʊ aɪ doʊnt noʊ wɛn aɪ ˈrɪli dɪˈsaɪdɪd aɪ ˈwɑntɪd tu bi ən ˌɛndʒəˈnɪr, bʌt aɪ aɪ nu ðæt aɪ ˈwɑntɪd tu bi ɪn ði ˌænəˈlɪtɪkəl fildz ənd ʌ ɪn mæθ ənd ˈsaɪəns ˈɛvər sɛns aɪ wʌz kwaɪt jʌŋ./
sentences.zh: 所以我不清楚自己是什么时候真正决定想成为一名工程师的，但我很小的时候就知道自己想从事分析领域，以及数学和科学。

sentences.zh: 嗯，我还是很害羞，我还是我还是不会去寻求公众演讲的机会，问问你妈妈就知道了。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Uh she she I try to resist almost all invitations.
sentences.ipa: /ʌ əʃi ʃi ə aɪ traɪ tu rɪˈzɪst ˈɔlmoʊst ɔl ˌɪnvəˈteɪʃənz/

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Uh when you communicate though when you're speaking, what when you and I are speaking right now, and when I'm speaking to people I care about,.
sentences.ipa: /ʌ wɛn ju kəˈmjunəˌkeɪt ðoʊ ə wɛn jʊər ˈspikɪŋ wʌt wɛn ju ənd aɪ ɑr ˈspikɪŋ raɪt naʊ ə ənd wɛn aɪm ˈspikɪŋ tu əm ˈpipəl aɪ kɛr əˈbaʊt/
sentences.zh: 呃，不过当你交流时，呃，当你在说话时，也就是你和我现在谈话时，呃，以及当我向我关心的其他人说话时，

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Uh or talking on a particular matter that's important to me,.
sentences.ipa: /ʌ ɔr ˈtɑkɪŋ ɑn ə pərˈtɪkjələr ˈmætər ðæts ɪmˈpɔrtənt tu mi/
sentences.zh: 呃，或者谈论对我很重要的某个事情时，

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Uh there are several things that that that I've learned that's that's really about at the core important to communications,.
sentences.ipa: /ʌ ðɛr ɑr ˈsɛvrəl θɪŋz ðæt ðæt ðæt aɪv lɜrnd ðæts ðæts ˈrɪli əˈbaʊt æt ðə kɔr əm ə ɪmˈpɔrtənt tu kəˌmjunəˈkeɪʃənz/
sentences.zh: 呃，我学到了几点，这些可以说是交流的核心，呃，非常重要，

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Which is number one, know your subject matter.
sentences.ipa: /wɪtʃ ɪz ˈnʌmbər wʌn noʊ jʊər ˈsʌbdʒɪkt ˈmætər/

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang

sentences.zh: 呃，不要谈论你不知道的事情，要谈论你确实知道的事情。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: Um, but know them.
sentences.ipa: /ʌm bʌt noʊ ðɛm/
sentences.zh: 嗯，但要真正了解它们。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: You know, know the things that you know.
sentences.ipa: /ju noʊ noʊ ðə θɪŋz ðæt ju noʊ ənd/
sentences.zh: 你知道，了解你所了解的事情。

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: And and then secondarily, or even more important than that, be thoughtful of the audience you're talking to and be empathetic to what's important to them,.
sentences.ipa: /ənd ənd ðɛn ˈsɛkənˌdɛrəli əm ə or ˈivən mɔr ɪmˈpɔrtənt ðən ðæt ə bi ˈθɔtfəl ʌv ði ˈɑdiəns jʊər ˈtɑkɪŋ tu ənd bi ˈɛmpəˌθɛtɪk tu ðɛm wʌts ɪmˈpɔrtənt tu ðɛm/

sentences.speaker: Jensen Huang
sentences.en: And try to make the time that they've spent listening to you worthwhile.

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Okay, Jennie, there's so much here because you guys all have your own stories.
sentences.ipa: /ðɛrz soʊ mʌtʃ hɪər bɪˈkʌz juː ɡaɪz ɔl hæv jər oʊn ˈstɔriz/
sentences.zh: 好的 Jennie，这里面故事可太多了，因为你们每个人都有自己独特的经历。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: You learned English by going to school in New Zealand, right?
sentences.ipa: /juː lɜrnd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ baɪ ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː skuːl ɪn nuː ˈziːlənd raɪt/
sentences.zh: 你是在新西兰上学学会英语的，对吧？

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Why go back to Korea and why dive into the trainee program and...
sentences.ipa: /waɪ ɡoʊ bæk tuː kəˈriːə ənd waɪ daɪv ˈɪntuː ðə ˈtreɪni ˈproʊɡræm ənd/
sentences.zh: 为什么要回韩国，为什么要投入练习生项目，然后……

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Really, I'm assuming...
sentences.ipa: /ˈrɪli aɪm əˈsuːmɪŋ/
sentences.zh: 真的，我猜……

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Or did you always want to do this? Like, sorry.
sentences.ipa: /ɔːr dɪd juː ˈɔlweɪz wɑːnt tuː duː ðɪs laɪk ˈsɑːri/
sentences.zh: 还是你一直都想做这个？抱歉。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: So, when I was in New Zealand, I lived by myself, like my family was living in Korea.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ wɛn aɪ wʌz ɪn nuː ˈziːlənd aɪ lɪvd baɪ maɪˈsɛlf laɪk maɪ ˈfæməli wʌz ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn kəˈriːə/

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: And you were so young.
sentences.ipa: /ənd juː wɜr soʊ jʌŋ/
sentences.zh: 而且你当时那么小。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: I know, I was I was 10 when I went there.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ noʊ aɪ wʌz aɪ wʌz tɛn wɛn aɪ wɛnt ðɛər/
sentences.zh: 我知道，我去那里的时候才10岁。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: And so by the time I turned 14, 15, my mom wanted me to actually move move me to the States, like.
sentences.ipa: /ənd soʊ baɪ ðə taɪm aɪ aɪ tɜrnd ˈfɔrtiːn fɪfˈtiːn maɪ mɑːm ˈwɑntɪd miː tuː ˈæktʃuəli muːv miː muːv miː tuː ðə steɪts laɪk/
sentences.zh: 所以到了我14、15岁的时候，我妈妈实际上想让我搬去美国，就像……

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: I think in Florida, yeah, she had plans to move me.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪn ˈflɔrɪdə jæʃ iː hæd plænz tuː muːv miː/
sentences.zh: 我想是在佛罗里达，对，她有计划让我搬过去。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Beautiful Florida.
sentences.ipa: /ˈbjutəfəl ˈflɔrɪdə/
sentences.zh: 美丽的佛罗里达。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: Yeah, we we actually went took a trip to Florida, saw the school, just saw the place that I would live in.
sentences.ipa: /jæ wiː wiː ˈæktʃuəli wɛnt tʊk ə trɪp tuː ˈflɔrɪdə sɔː ðə skuːl dʒʌst sɔː ðə pleɪs ðæt aɪ wʊd lɪv ɪn/
sentences.zh: 对，我们实际上去佛罗里达旅行了一趟，看了看学校，看了看我将要居住的地方。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: And it hit me like, I don't want to live by myself in Florida, not knowing what I want to do.
sentences.ipa: /ənd ɪt hɪt miː laɪk aɪ doʊnt wɑːnt tuː lɪv baɪ maɪˈsɛlf ɪn ˈflɔrɪdə nɑːt ˈnoʊɪŋ wʌt aɪ wɑːnt tuː duː/
sentences.zh: 然后我突然意识到：我不想一个人住在佛罗里达，还不知道自己想做什么。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: And I started thinking what I want to do and it was really like I was like, out of nowhere I was like, I want to do music.
sentences.ipa: /ənd aɪ ˈstɑrtɪd ˈθɪŋkɪŋ wʌt aɪ wɑːnt tuː duː ənd ɪt wʌz ˈrɪli laɪk aɪ wʌz laɪk aʊt əv ˈnoʊwɛr aɪ wʌz laɪk aɪ wɑːnt tuː duː ˈmjuːzɪk/
sentences.zh: 然后我开始思考我想做什么，真的就像是，突然之间我觉得，我想做音乐。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: I want to like learn how to dance and stuff like that.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ wɑːnt tuː laɪk lɜrn haʊ tuː dæns ənd stʌf laɪk ðæt/
sentences.zh: 我想学跳舞之类的东西。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: So I told my mom, mom, instead of going to a new school, why don't I just come home and do something that I would enjoy for the rest of my life? And she was supportive with it and that's how it all started.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ aɪ toʊld maɪ mɑːm mɑːm ɪnˈstɛd əv ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː ə nuː skuːl waɪ doʊnt aɪ dʒʌst kʌm hoʊm ənd duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt aɪ wʊd ɪnˈdʒɔɪ fɔːr ðə rɛst əv maɪ laɪf ənd ʃiː wʌz səˈpɔrtɪv wɪð ɪt ənd ðæts haʊ ˈɪt ɔl ˈstɑrtɪd/
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉妈妈，妈妈，与其去一所新学校，为什么我不能回家，做一些我余生都会喜欢的事情呢？她很支持我，这就是这一切开始的原因。

sentences.speaker: Jennie

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: See, I used to have a stronger accent, but it's completely gone.
sentences.ipa: /si, aɪ juzd tu hæv ə ˈstrɔŋgər ˈæksənt, bʌt ɪts kəmˈplitli gɔn./
sentences.zh: 你看，我以前口音很重，但现在完全没有了。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: I think this is a New Zealand thing about me.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ θɪŋk ðɪs ɪz ə nu ˈzilənd θɪŋ əˈbaʊt mi./
sentences.zh: 我想这是关于我的一个新西兰特色吧。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: So me and Rosie were the only excited people when we were in a city and they sort provide us with Vegemite or Marmite.
sentences.ipa: /so mi ænd ˈrozi wɜr ði ˈoʊnli ɪkˈsaɪtəd ˈpipəl wɛn wi wɜr ɪn ə ˈsɪti ænd ðeɪ sɔrt prəˈvaɪd ʌs wɪð ˈvɛʤɪˌmaɪt ɔr ˈmɑrˌmaɪt./
sentences.zh: 所以我和罗茜是仅有的两个很兴奋的人，当我们身处某个城市，而他们提供给我们维吉麦或马麦酱时。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: When did Jennie release solo?
sentences.ipa: /wɛn dɪd ˈʤɛni riˈlis ˈsoʊloʊ?/
sentences.zh: 珍妮什么时候发行了个人单曲？

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: Five years ago, I want to say.
sentences.ipa: /faɪv jɪrz əˈgoʊ, aɪ wɑnt tu seɪ./
sentences.zh: 我想说是五年前吧。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: Six years ago, five years ago? I think five, my bets on five.
sentences.ipa: /sɪks jɪrz əˈgoʊ, faɪv jɪrz əˈgoʊ? aɪ θɪŋk faɪv, maɪ bɛts ɑn faɪv./
sentences.zh: 六年前，五年前？我觉得是五年，我赌五年。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: It feels like it was such a long time ago, cuz while preparing for mantra, I looked back at the videos and photos of me from back in the solo days, and I was like, wow, I look so young and cute.
sentences.ipa: /ɪt filz laɪk ɪt wəz sʌʧ ə lɔŋ taɪm əˈgoʊ, kəz waɪl prɪˈpɛrɪŋ fɔr ˈmɑntrə, aɪ lʊkt bæk æt ði ˈvɪdioʊz ænd ˈfoʊtoʊz ʌv mi frəm bæk ɪn ðə ˈsoʊloʊ deɪz, ænd aɪ wəz laɪk, waʊ, aɪ lʊk soʊ jʌŋ ænd kyut./
sentences.zh: 感觉已经是好久以前的事了，因为在准备《Mantra》时，我翻看了自己当年solo时期的视频和照片，心想：哇，我看起来好年轻好可爱。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: It's definitely different working as a solo artist.
sentences.ipa: /ɪts ˈdɛfənətli ˈdɪfrənt ˈwɜrkɪŋ æz ə ˈsoʊloʊ ˈɑrtɪst./
sentences.zh: 作为独唱艺人工作确实很不一样。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: I'm in this studio alone, first of all.
sentences.ipa: /aɪm ɪn ðɪs ˈstudioʊ əˈloʊn, fɜrst əv ɔl./
sentences.zh: 首先，我一个人在这个录音室里。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: When I was working on the group stuff, I talked a lot with the girls on if we all agree and relate to the song a lot, but now I have to make all of those decisions on my own.
sentences.ipa: /wɛn aɪ wəz ˈwɜrkɪŋ ɑn ðə grup stʌf, aɪ tɔkt ə lɔt wɪð ðə gɜrlz ɑn ɪf wi ɔl əˈgri ænd rɪˈleɪt tu ðə sɔŋ ə lɔt, bʌt naʊ aɪ hæv tu meɪk ɔl əv ðoʊz dɪˈsɪʒənz ɑn maɪ oʊn./
sentences.zh: 以前做组合的时候，我会和女孩们聊很多，看大家是否都赞同并且对歌曲很有共鸣，但现在我必须自己做所有这些决定。

sentences.speaker: Jennie
sentences.en: So I think that's the biggest difference that I have.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ aɪ θɪŋk ðæts ðə ˈbɪgəst ˈdɪfrəns ðæt aɪ hæv./
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这是我面临的最大区别。

practiceQuestions.qEn: How did Simone Biles describe the Paris Olympics compared to Tokyo?
practiceQuestions.qZh: 西蒙·拜尔斯如何形容巴黎奥运会与东京奥运会的对比？
practiceQuestions.aEn: She said it meant everything, especially coming off of Tokyo where she didn't have her best performance.
practiceQuestions.aZh: 她说这意味著一切，尤其是刚经历了她在东京未能发挥出最好水平的奥运会。

practiceQuestions.qEn: Why was Simone Biles nervous during the closing ceremonies?
practiceQuestions.qZh: 为什么西蒙·拜尔斯在闭幕式上会感到紧张？
practiceQuestions.aEn: She was nervous about handing the flag off to Tom Cruise without making a mistake.
practiceQuestions.aZh: 她紧张是因为要把旗帜交接给汤姆·克鲁斯，害怕出错。

practiceQuestions.qEn: What did Tom Cruise bring when he met Simone Biles?
practiceQuestions.qZh: 汤姆·克鲁斯见西蒙·2拜尔斯时带了什么？
practiceQuestions.aEn: He brought flowers.
practiceQuestions.aZh: 他带了花。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: Has it sunken in? What did it mean to you? What did the Paris Olympics mean to you?
sentences.ipa: /hæz ɪt ˈsʌŋkən ɪn? wʌt dɪd ɪt min tu ju? wʌt dɪd ðə ˈpærɪs oʊˈlɪmpɪks min tu ju?/
sentences.zh: 它沉淀下来了吗？这对你意味着什么？巴黎奥运会对你意味着什么？

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: It meant everything, especially coming off of Tokyo.
sentences.ipa: /ɪt mɛnt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ, ɪˈspɛʃəli ˈkʌmɪŋ ɔf ʌv ˈtoʊkyoʊ./
sentences.zh: 这意味著一切，尤其是刚经历了东京奥运会。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: Um, that wasn't my best performance or how I planned for it to go.
sentences.ipa: /ʌm, ðæt ˈwɑzənt maɪ bɛst pərˈfɔrməns ɔr haʊ aɪ plænd fər ɪt tu goʊ./
sentences.zh: 嗯，那不是我最好的表现，也不是我计划中的样子。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: So, to put the work in mentally and physically and to be back on a world stage, competing at an Olympic Games, meant everything to me.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ, tu pʊt ðə wɜrk ɪn ˈmɛntəli ənd ˈfɪzɪkli ənd tu bi bæk ɑn ə wɜrld steɪʤ, kəmˈpitɪŋ æt ən oʊˈlɪmpɪk geɪmz mɛnt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ tu mi./
sentences.zh: 所以，在精神和身体上付出努力，重新回到世界舞台，在奥运会上竞技，对我来说意味著一切。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Did it feel like double the pressure because of Tokyo and now you?
sentences.ipa: /dɪd ɪt fil laɪk ˈdʌbəl ðə ˈprɛʃər bɪˈkʌz ʌv ˈtoʊkyoʊ ənd naʊ ju?/
sentences.zh: 是因为东京奥运会以及现在的你，让你觉得压力倍增吗？

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: Not necessarily, I feel like the only pressure I put was on myself because I knew I could do it and I wanted to do it so bad.
sentences.ipa: /nɑt ˈnɛsəˌsɛrəli, aɪ fil laɪk ði ˈoʊnli ˈprɛʃər aɪ pʊt wʌz ɑn maɪˈsɛlf bɪˈkʌz aɪ nu aɪ kʊd du ɪt ənd aɪ ˈwɑntɪd tu du ɪt soʊ bæd./
sentences.zh: 倒也不见得，我觉得我唯一的压力是施加在自己身上的，因为我知道我能做到，而且我非常渴望做到。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: So that was like the only stressful part, everything else was how it was supposed to be.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ ðæt wʌz laɪk ði ˈoʊnli ˈstrɛsfəl pɑrt, ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɛls wʌz haʊ ɪt wʌz səˈpoʊzd tu bi./
sentences.zh: 所以那是唯一让人感到压力的地方，其他一切都按部就班。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: You are so fun to watch.
sentences.ipa: /ju ɑr soʊ fʌn tu wɑtʃ./
sentences.zh: 看你比赛太有趣了。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: It is amazing to watch you do anything.
sentences.ipa: /ɪt ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ tu wɑtʃ ju du ˈɛniˌθɪŋ./
sentences.zh: 看你做什么都觉得惊艳。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: But I I saw you posted this, this is you with your 11 Olympic medals.
sentences.ipa: /bʌt aɪ aɪ aɪ sɔ ju ˈpoʊstɪd ðɪs, ðɪs ɪz ju wɪð jʊr ɪˈlɛvən oʊˈlɪmpɪk ˈmɛdəlz./
sentences.zh: 不过我看到你发了这张照片，这是你带着11枚奥运奖牌。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: And it says in the bottom, six-year-old me would be proud.
sentences.ipa: /ænd ɪt sɛz ɪn ðə ˈbɑtəm, sɪks-jɪr-oʊld mi wʊd bi praʊd./
sentences.zh: 底下写著：六岁的小我一定会为我骄傲。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: I mean, she would be proud.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ min, ʃi wʊd bi praʊd./
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她一定会骄傲的。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: Yes, she was definitely accomplished more than my wildest dreams whenever I first started gymnastics.
sentences.ipa: /jɛs, ʃi wʌz ˈdɛfənətli əˈkɑmplɪʃt mɔr ðɛn maɪ ˈwaɪldɪst drimz wɛnˈɛvər aɪ fɜrst ˈstɑrtɪd ʤɪmˈnæstɪks./
sentences.zh: 是的，她取得的成就绝对超过了我刚开始练体操时最狂野的梦想。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: You you did a great job, the team did a great job.
sentences.ipa: /ju ju dɪd ə greɪt ʤɑb, ðə tim dɪd ə greɪt ʤɑb./
sentences.zh: 你们表现得太棒了，团队表现得太棒了。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: But also then you got to carry the flag at closing ceremonies and hand it off to Tom Cruise.
sentences.ipa: /bʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ðɛn ju gɑt tu ˈkæri ðə flæg æt ˈkloʊzɪŋ ˈsɛrəˌmoʊniz ænd hænd ɪt ɔf tu tɑm kruz./
sentences.zh: 而且后来你还在闭幕式上举着旗帜，并把它交给了汤姆·克鲁斯。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: And I was thinking, and I was just go, he's the biggest movie star.
sentences.ipa: /ænd aɪ wʌz ˈθɪŋkɪŋ, ænd aɪ wʌz ʤʌst goʊ, hiz ðə ˈbɪgɪst ˈmuvi stɑr./
sentences.zh: 当时我在想，他可是超级大牌电影明星。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: I was just like, I know you have pressures on you to do your performance, but that is a little pressure right there to hand off.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ wʌz ʤʌst laɪk, aɪ noʊ ju hæv ˈprɛʃərz ɑn ju tu du jʊr pərˈfɔrməns, bʌt ðæt ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl ˈprɛʃər raɪt ðɛr tu hænd ɔf./
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，我知道你要承受表演的压力，但把旗帜交出去也是不小的压力。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: And I'm always tripping, falling downstairs like bad for me.
sentences.ipa: /ænd aɪm ˈɔlweɪz ˈtrɪpɪŋ, ˈfɔlɪŋ ˈdaʊnˌstɛrz laɪk bæd fər mi./
sentences.zh: 而且我总是笨手笨脚的，下楼梯都会摔倒，对我来说太糟糕了。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: So actually that's like the most nervous I was for the whole entire Olympics, I was like, oh god, I have to hand the flag up like, don't mess it up, don't mess it up. I was terrified.
sentences.ipa: /soʊ ˈækʧuəli ðæts laɪk ðə moʊst ˈnɜrvəs aɪ wʌz fər ðə hoʊl ɪnˈtaɪər oʊˈlɪmpɪks, aɪ wʌz laɪk, oʊ gɑd, aɪ hæv tu hænd ðə flæg ʌp laɪk, doʊnt mɛs ɪt ʌp, doʊnt mɛs ɪt ʌp. aɪ wʌz ˈtɛrəˌfaɪd./
sentences.zh: 所以实际上那是我整个奥运会期间最紧张的一次，我心想，天哪，我得把旗帜递过去，千万别搞砸了。我当时吓坏了。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.ipa: /jæ./
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: How was Tom Cruise?
sentences.ipa: /haʊ wʌz tɑm kruz?/
sentences.zh: 汤姆·克鲁斯人怎么样？

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: He was so sweet, so nice, down to earth.
sentences.ipa: /hi wʌz soʊ swit, soʊ naɪs, daʊn tu ɜrθ./
sentences.zh: 他超级温柔、人很好，而且非常脚踏实地。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: He brought flowers, he got to meet my mom, and it was just like so much fun.
sentences.ipa: /hi brɔt ˈflaʊərz, hi gɑt tu mit maɪ mɑm, ənd ɪt wʌz ʤʌst laɪk soʊ mʌʧ fʌn./
sentences.zh: 他带了花，还见了我妈妈，真的太开心了。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: He's a good guy, he's got great stories.
sentences.ipa: /hiz ə gʊd gaɪ, hiz gɑt greɪt ˈstɔriz./
sentences.zh: 他是个好人，有很多精彩的故事。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: I mean, I can't even believe he jumped, of course, he had to repel.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ min, aɪ aɪ kænt ˈivən bɪˈliv hi ʤʌmpt, əv kɔrs, hi hæd tu rɪˈpɛl./
sentences.zh: 我是说，我简直不敢相信他跳伞了，当然，他得速降。

sentences.speaker: Simone Biles
sentences.en: Yeah, I wouldn't do that.
sentences.ipa: /jæ, aɪ ˈwʊdənt du ðæt./
sentences.zh: 对啊，我可不会那样做。

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: You wouldn't do that, right?
sentences.ipa: /ju ˈwʊdənt du ðæt, raɪt?/
sentences.zh: 你不会那样做，对吧？

sentences.speaker: Interviewer
sentences.en: No one would do that. Yeah, that's frightening.
sentences.ipa: /noʊ wʌn wʊd du ðæt. jæ, ðæts ˈfraɪtənɪŋ./
sentences.zh: 没人会那样做。对啊，那太吓人了。
